tagline: Secure the cloud. Own the future.
description: A 12-week guided path into cloud security fundamentals. Built for beginners who want to protect modern infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
outcome: Cloud security projects, audit experience, and readiness for cloud security roles.

phases.title: Phase 1 — Cloud & IT Foundations
phases.subtitle: Weeks 1–4 · Learn the cloud from the ground up

items.title: Cloud Basics
items.detail: Understand IaaS, PaaS, SaaS — and how AWS, Azure, and GCP differ.

items.title: Linux & Networking Refresher
items.detail: Command line, IP addressing, and how cloud networks are structured.

items.title: Identity & Access Management
items.detail: Users, roles, policies — the #1 security control in any cloud.

items.title: Mini Project: Launch & Secure a VM
items.detail: Spin up a free-tier VM, lock down ports, and enable logging.

phases.title: Phase 2 — Cloud Security Core
phases.subtitle: Weeks 5–8 · Learn how cloud misconfigurations become breaches

items.title: Shared Responsibility Model
items.detail: What the cloud provider secures vs. what you must secure.

items.title: Cloud Security Posture Management
items.detail: Use tools like Prowler to audit your cloud for misconfigurations.

items.title: Container Basics
items.detail: Docker and Kubernetes fundamentals — where modern apps live.

items.title: Mini Project: Audit a Misconfigured Lab
items.detail: Find exposed S3 buckets, weak IAM policies, and open ports.

phases.title: Phase 3 — Cloud Security Career
phases.subtitle: Weeks 9–12 · Get certified and get hired

items.title: Certification Prep
items.detail: Study for AWS Security Specialty or Azure Security Engineer.

items.title: Cloud SIEM & Monitoring
items.detail: Learn AWS GuardDuty, CloudTrail, and Azure Sentinel basics.

items.title: Practice Cloud CTFs
items.detail: Hands-on challenges in real cloud environments — flaws.cloud and more.

items.title: Build a Cloud Security Portfolio
items.detail: Two projects with writeups — audits, hardening, or detection rules.
